bundle.description: Topo, imagery, LiDAR relief and contours, forest stands, water, roads, and the habitat, wind and going grids around Duhamel; full detail within 5 km of the spot.

forest.vintage: 4th inventory, with cuts, burns and outbreaks to 2025

basemap.missing: not baked: the map draws the live NRCan base map

topo.source: Toporama hypsography (contours and spot heights), NRCan WMS

satellite.source: Imagerie_GQ WMTS, MRNF: the 20 cm ortho

hillshade.missing: not baked: the map shades the relief from the DEM

hillshadeLidar.source: HRDEM 1 m LiDAR DTM, NRCan: NRCAN-FHIMP_PICAI_PetiteNation_LAssomption_2022-1m, gaps filled from QC-600021_46_RiviereGatineauLievre_2021-1m, QC-600018-23_DIF_Grand_Mtl_MTM9_2018-1m, QC-2015_600014-47_MTM09-1m

dem.source: MRDEM 30 m, with HRDEM 1 m LiDAR over the core (NRCAN-FHIMP_PICAI_PetiteNation_LAssomption_2022-1m, gaps filled from QC-600021_46_RiviereGatineauLievre_2021-1m, QC-600018-23_DIF_Grand_Mtl_MTM9_2018-1m, QC-2015_600014-47_MTM09-1m), NRCan

contours.source: HRDEM 1 m LiDAR DTM, NRCan: NRCAN-FHIMP_PICAI_PetiteNation_LAssomption_2022-1m, gaps filled from QC-600021_46_RiviereGatineauLievre_2021-1m, QC-600018-23_DIF_Grand_Mtl_MTM9_2018-1m, QC-2015_600014-47_MTM09-1m

forest.source: Carte écoforestière (MRNF), with later cuts, burns and outbreaks laid over
forest.vintage: 4th inventory, with cuts, burns and outbreaks to 2025

understory.source: MRNF LiDAR 2014_Outaouais_LiDAR, flown 2015-06-07; MRNF LiDAR 2018_Laurentides_LiDAR, flown 2018-06-11 to 2018-06-25; MRNF LiDAR 2022_OutaouaisLaurentidesLanaudiereEstrie_LiDAR, flown 2022-05-10 to 2022-05-11; heights above the tiles' own ground returns

lanes.source: MRNF LiDAR 2014_Outaouais_LiDAR, flown 2015-06-07; MRNF LiDAR 2018_Laurentides_LiDAR, flown 2018-06-11 to 2018-06-25; MRNF LiDAR 2022_OutaouaisLaurentidesLanaudiereEstrie_LiDAR, flown 2022-05-10 to 2022-05-11; heights above the tiles' own ground returns

bathy.missing: Ontario only: lake depths need the ARA lake facts and the MNR sheets

bathySheets.missing: Ontario only: MNR lake survey sheets

places.source: TRQ territories, the carte écoforestière's burns and AQréseau roads, MRNF

wmu.missing: not in the maps: the hunting zones' only source (SmartFaune) states no licence, so the area file names the zone instead

camps.missing: Ontario only: Crown land camps come from LIO

crown.missing: Ontario only: Crown land comes from LIO

lots.missing: no open lot lines: Quebec's cadastre states no licence, and baking it needs the MRNF's written permission

bathy.missing: Ontario only: lake bathymetry comes from LIO

fire.source: Burns from the carte écoforestière (ca_feu), MRNF

roads.source: AQréseau (Adresses Québec, MRNF): Collectrice (3), Locale (389), Autre route (1294)

forest.missing: not in the maps as GeoJSON: the map reads the stands from the forest tiles, and the GeoJSON stays the bake's input

depth.missing: Ontario only: lake depths need the ARA lake facts and the MNR sheets

habitat.source: derived: MRDEM, NRCan 2020 land cover, forest stands, water, wetlands, roads and burns
habitat.note: stand height and closure from the LiDAR point cloud over 48% of the core

micro.source: derived: the habitat grid and the MRDEM

going.source: derived: HRDEM LiDAR, point-cloud bush or the forest-map estimate, water, wetlands and roads

micro-sd.source: derived: the habitat grid and the MRDEM, with the surrogate net's terrain wind in WindNinja's place (build_windsd.py)
